reviewItem.question: For "Log messages across cert-manager have been augmented with better contextual structured data", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether external log tooling (alerts, parsers, searches) matches literal strings in cert-manager log lines

proposed.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, log messages now carry better contextual structured data, so anything that matches literal strings in log lines may break.
